candidates.description: These tokens represent subword fragments and characters from the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.
This vector activates on characters, fragments, and words from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector is related to character sequences and vowel sign combinations in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents sub-word tokens and character fragments from Hindi and other scripts, capturing common morphological suffixes and root components.
This feature vector represents first- and second-person pronouns and related terms in Hindi.
These tokens represent consonants and characters from the Devanagari script used for writing various Indo-Aryan languages.
This vector is related to Hindi consonant-vowel conjuncts and Devanagari characters, particularly those featuring the 'u' vowel matra (u, uu).
This vector activates on common Hindi vowel matras followed by punctuation marks.
This vector represents common Hindi prefixes, suffixes, and character combinations frequently found in Devanagari script.
This vector represents characters, diacritics, and symbols primarily associated with Indic scripts and multilingual typography.
